episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her insights on the critical role of YouTube titles and thumbnails in driving video engagement. She discusses common mistakes agents make, offers strategies for creating curiosity-driven titles, and emphasizes the importance of professional thumbnail design. Sarah also highlights the use of AI tools and outsourcing to enhance video marketing efforts.
